why: padding_waste measured 74.47% against the 15% gate on this distribution under equal-count quantile bucketing: 2,449 sequences above p96.9 (713 tokens) shared one bucket padded to the 37,098-token maximum. choose_buckets is fitted to a length distribution, so its regression test needs this one.
